opis.sh: Prvobitna grobnica iza opštine čuvala je posmrtne ostatke 80 boraca i 76 žrtava fašističkog terora; centralno obeležje izradio je Slobodan Lukić. Oštećena je devedesetih, poslednji ostaci obeležja uklonjeni su 2016, a zamenski memorijal podignut je 2006. na drugom mestu.
opis.en: The original collective grave behind the municipal building held 80 fighters and 76 victims of fascist terror; Slobodan Lukić designed its central memorial. It was damaged in the 1990s, its last memorial remains were removed in 2016, and a replacement was erected elsewhere in 2006.

opis.sh: Memorijalno groblje obeležavalo je i mesto formiranja IV krajiške brigade; sadržalo je bronzanu figuru i mozaički zid.

opis.en: Vasilije Ćetković’s 1968 fountain commemorated fallen fighters; its relief and star had already disappeared. Renovation in 2020–2023 removed the remaining WWII memorial elements and added a different dedication, so it is not treated as a surviving WWII memorial.

opis.en: The former memorial in the churchyard marked the capture of [Mladen Stojanović](Q1263753). It was removed; a 1969 historical account had already proposed removal because of its condition and inscription errors.

opis.en: Commemorated the Partisan attack on the garrison in 1943. The 1955 plaque was later replaced, but only the memorial’s foundations remained by 2012; its return has not been confirmed.

opis.en: The former memorial to fallen WWII Partisans reused the pedestal of King Petar I’s monument on the town square. It was removed in 1993 when the king’s statue was reinstated.

opis.en: The former ossuary of fallen fighters stood in the park along the former 7 Aprila Street. It was removed; the retained point is an estimate of its former location.

opis.sh: Statua neznanog partizana Ive Despić-Simonović stajala je na postolju ranijeg spomenika kralju Aleksandru, čiji je autor bio Lojze Dolinar. Najverovatnije je nastala početkom pedesetih i slučajno je uništena pri uklanjanju između maja 1963. i juna 1967.
opis.en: Iva Despić-Simonović’s statue of an unknown Partisan stood on the pedestal of an earlier King Alexander monument by Lojze Dolinar. Probably made in the early 1950s, it was accidentally destroyed during removal between May 1963 and June 1967.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1961. kod jame uništen je 1992; ostali su platforma i razbacani delovi. Tačan položaj ostataka nije potvrđen, pa prethodna procenjena tačka nije predstavljena kao precizna lokacija.
opis.en: The 1961 memorial by the pit was destroyed in 1992, leaving a platform and scattered fragments. The exact position of the remains is unconfirmed, so the former estimated point is not presented as an exact location.

opis.sh: Od spomen-česme kod izvora Markovac sačuvana je oštećena konstrukcija, dok je ploča uništena između 1995. i 2016. Tačan položaj nije potvrđen; prethodna tačka bila je pretpostavka sa stare karte izvora.
opis.en: The memorial fountain at Markovac spring survives as a damaged structure, while its plaque was destroyed between 1995 and 2016. Its exact position is unconfirmed; the former point was an inference from an old map of springs.

opis.sh: Katalog ga beleži kao nekadašnje obeležje Đuri Pucaru Starom. Današnji „Novotravnički čekić“ obnovljen je i u martu 2025. dobio je novu ploču o industrijskoj prošlosti grada, bez ranije lične posvete.
opis.en: The catalogue records it as a former memorial to Đuro Pucar Stari. The present “Novi Travnik Hammer” was restored and received a new plaque about the town’s industrial past in March 2025, without the former personal dedication.

opis.sh: Bista Džemala Mandžića, delo Aleksandra Zarina iz 1988, nestala je ispred Osnovne škole „Pazar“. Preostalo postolje ne potvrđuje da je bista sačuvana.
opis.en: Aleksandar Zarin’s 1988 bust of Džemal Mandžić is missing from Pazar Elementary School. The surviving pedestal does not establish the survival of the bust.

opis.sh: Memorijal sa kosturnicom i bistom Ranka Šipke postojao je uz most pre 1965. Uklonjen je; na nekadašnjoj parceli od 2011. građen je hotel, a bista je već pre 1997. bila uništena.
opis.en: A memorial with an ossuary and Ranko Šipka’s bust stood beside the bridge before 1965. It has been removed; hotel construction began on the former plot in 2011, and the bust had already been destroyed before 1997.

opis.sh: Grobnica sa bistom Joze Lozovine Mosora, organizatora ustanka na trogirskom području. Minirana je 1991. godine.
